//: FRAGMENT fixture for the per-GAUGE tile of the KPI comparison-gauges design — the `pa-kpi-gauge` CLEAN BLOCK (svelte `display/KpiGauge.svelte`, keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiGaugeList.kpi_gauge/1`). This is the sub-component the kpi-gauge-list CONTAINER fixture defers (its gauge tiles arrive through the default slot as escaped text, so they can't materialize there). Tested in isolation here. SCOPE = the gauge tile: the block + its 4 sentiment modifiers (--positive/--warning/--negative/--neutral, which set --pa-kpi-bar-color), the head row (__head > __label + __value(__num/__unit)), the bar (__bar + __fill with the INLINE fill width), and the 0/tgt scale row (__scale). Authored from snippets/kpi.html L404-440 (comparison-gauges section) + _kpi-comparison-gauges.scss. NOTE `pa-kpi-gauge-list` is the sibling CONTAINER block — this fixture's block is the hyphen-joined `pa-kpi-gauge`, so axis-1's reverse checks scope to pa-kpi-gauge--* / pa-kpi-gauge__* only and never touch pa-kpi-gauge-list. The gauge's detail popover (keen Kpi.kpi_detail / svelte KpiDetailPopover) is a SEPARATE sub-component (its own kpi-detail fixture) and only renders when detail props are set — none of these scenarios set them, so it stays out of this slice.
goldenConventions: The tile is a <div class="pa-kpi-gauge[ --variant]">. The head is ALWAYS emitted (__head > __label + __value); every scenario sets valueText so both wrappers emit the __num span (svelte emits an empty __num even without a value, keen omits it — so goldens only cover the value-present shape where they agree). Inside __value the order is prefix(__unit) · value(__num) · unit(__unit). The __bar ALWAYS wraps a __fill whose width is set INLINE as style="width: N%" — both wrappers serialize it identically (keen `width: #{fill}%`, svelte `width: {fill}%`), defaulting to `width: 0%` when no barPercent is given. The __bar gets an inline `--pa-kpi-gauge-tick-pos: …;` style ONLY when tickPosition is set (otherwise NO style attribute — keen omits nil, svelte must omit empty; see the phantom-style note). The __scale is ALWAYS emitted with two <span>s (left defaults to '0', right empty unless scaleEndText is set) — both wrappers agree on this default. No detail popover is exercised. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-gauge(--|__)'). The pa-kpi-gauge BLOCK carries 4 sentiment modifiers (--positive/--warning/--negative/--neutral), each setting --pa-kpi-bar-color (the fill reads it). Element classes: __head/__label/__value/__num/__unit/__bar/__fill/__scale — all produced/exercised by the scenarios below. `produces: null` = structural/native/inline-style (no class). barPercent / tickPosition are inline styles, not classes.

labelText.note: uppercase mono metric name in the head row

valueText.note: focal number inside __value; rendered in the __num span

unit.note: unit affix after the number (__unit span)

prefix.note: currency/scale affix before the number (also a __unit span)

barPercent.note: bar fill width as a percent; set INLINE on __fill as style="width: N%" (default 0). Integer (keen attr is :integer)

tickPosition.note: inline --pa-kpi-gauge-tick-pos on __bar; absence omits the style attribute entirely

scaleEndText.note: right scale label (e.g. 'tgt 90%'); the __scale row itself is structural — produced by the always-on scale

deferred.//: The hover detail popover is a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte KpiDetailPopover / keen Kpi.kpi_detail, covered by the kpi-detail fixture) that renders only when detail props are set — none of these scenarios set them, so no pa-kpi-detail* class appears and there is nothing here to defer. No pa-kpi-gauge* element class is left uncovered.
